items.name: Blood Caimon Tacos
items.description:
A famous recipe from Savage Sustenance, these spicy and flavorful tacos will surprise & delight any diners!
Enjoyer of these tacos is granted the Caimon Taco Buff, which grants +20 movement on a charge attack, a 20 swim speed and the ability to charge through water, and the ability to hold one's breath for 30 minutes.

items.name: Desert Coffee
items.description:
This particularly strong coffee is popular throughout the desert empires. A morning cup is a good cure for lack of rest, but many find that it becomes a habit.
Type ingested; Addiction minor, Fortitude DC 12
8 hours; user ignores the effects of the fatigued condition.
After 8 hours; the user becomes exhausted, which is reduced to fatigued only after at least 8 hours of rest (instead of 1 hour).
1 Wis damage

items.name: Bone Dice
items.description: Made from most creatures, mainly ankle bones from animals or otherwise, however, hooves, horns, and even antlers were also used. In the past the dice were not used for games, were used by religious figures with rocks, sticks, or even animal entrails, for fortune-telling. In some of the more remote regions playing dice might be an insult and is advisable against it.

items.name: Chocolate
items.description: Chocolate comes in many shapes, sizes, and tastes. It is a staple sweet primarily made from cocoa beans, sugar, and milk. A major ingredient used in many desserts such as pudding, cakes, and candy. It can be in a solid form like a candy bar or in a liquid form like hot chocolate, to fit various needs and tastes.

items.name: Bright Flame Sash
items.description:
A long crimson sash tied at the waist, this cloth never frays and trails glowing motes when Zhilin moves quickly. It flares when he moves through combat, accentuating every step of his deadly footwork.
Effect: Grants +5 ft. enhancement bonus to base land speed.
Special: Once per day, when the wearer uses Spell Combat, he may also cast Bladed Dash or Bladed Dash, Greater, if he has those spells prepared or spontaneously available.

Aura faint transmutation; CL 8th
Construction Cost 20,000 gp; Market Price 40,000 gp

Price 30 gp; Weight 25 lbs.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionA cannon ball is the ammunition of a cannon and many other siege firearms. Picking up or drawing a cannon ball requires a move action for Medium and Small creatures, but is a free action for Large and larger creatures.

items.name: Blood Caimon Hide
items.description:
Caimon Hide Armor is Buoyant and it bestows no armor check penalty on Swim checks attempted by the wearer. 
It's smooth texture allows for smooth movement through water, granting a small swim-skill bonus.  
It is slightly lighter than conventional hide armor, and allows for greater dexterity. 
All other armor check penalties apply as normal.

items.name: Spellbook
items.description: A spellbook has 100 pages of parchment, and each spell takes up one page per spell level (one page each for 0-level spells). A newly purchased spellbook contains no spells. A wizard character begins play with a spellbook containing the spells he knows.
